title: MuteBench: Modality Unavailability Tolerance Evaluation for Incomplete Multimodal Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2605.15235v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal physiological data powers clinical AI systems from intensive care units to wearable devices, but sensors routinely fail in practice. Two failure modes are common: modality missing, where an entire channel is absent, and within-modality missing, where a contiguous time segment is lost. No existing benchmark evaluates multiple fusion architectures under both failure modes at controlled severity levels across diverse clinical datasets. We present MuteBench, a benchmark covering 9 datasets from 7 clinical domains, 6 fusion architectures, and 2 missing-data modes over 125,000 samples. Through this benchmark, we find that architecture family is the strongest predictor of robustness, outweighing parameter count. Channel-independent models tolerate modality missing well but can be sensitive to within-modality missing, especially on short sequences. translated_title: MuteBench：面向不完整多模态融合的模态不可用容忍度评估
translated_abstract: 多模态生理数据为从重症监护病房到可穿戴设备的临床AI系统提供动力，但传感器在实践中经常发生故障。两种失效模式很常见：模态缺失，即整个通道完全缺失；以及模态内缺失，即连续的时间段数据丢失。目前尚无基准在可控严重程度下、跨多样化临床数据集，评估多种融合架构在这两种失效模式下的表现。我们提出了MuteBench，这是一个涵盖来自7个临床领域的9个数据集、6种融合架构和2种缺失数据模式的基准，共包含125,000个样本。通过该基准，我们发现架构家族是鲁棒性的最强预测因子，其影响力超过参数数量。通道独立的模型能够很好地容忍模态缺失，但对模态内缺失可能较为敏感，尤其是在短序列上。课程式模态丢弃策略仅在不超过训练时使用的最大丢弃率的情况下才能提供可靠的保护。
tldr: MuteBench是一个评估多模态融合架构在模态缺失和模态内缺失两种失效模式下鲁棒性的大规模基准，研究发现架构家族是决定鲁棒性的最强预测因子，其重要性超过参数数量。
en_tdlr: MuteBench is a large-scale benchmark evaluating the robustness of multimodal fusion architectures under modality missing and within-modality missing failures, finding that architecture family is the strongest predictor of robustness, outweighing parameter count.
